items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: But he joined us in Texas.

ctx.x: I'm trying to think, because there was something that Crooke told me, Crooke said that there was at one time Herschel Edwards could have joined the band but everybody liked Lee Hilliard because he played three instruments. He played trumpet and clarinet and saxophone.
That's right. Equally well. But he joined us in Texas.
